value.rationale: This is a natural finite-field instance of an explicit current conjecture, and the witness closes two of the three dimensions between the generic extension-field construction and the conjectural target. A fully certified finite construction is meaningful even though the six-dimensional case remains open.

final_claim: There exists an explicit five-dimensional \(\mathbb F_3\)-linear subspace of \(M_3(\mathbb F_3)\) whose only nilpotent element is zero, so the maximum nilpotent-free dimension in this case is at least five, one below the six-dimensional target of Wigderson's Conjecture 8.
limitations: No maximality claim is made; a six-dimensional example may exist.
The result is specific to \(3\times3\) matrices over \(\mathbb F_3\).
